Res.Caption: Base Rate
Res.FullDescription: Exchange Rate is based on Rate Type and Date Preference specified in Job Billing Exchange Rate Configuration (at Organization, Account Group, Company or System level).

Res.Caption: Today's Rate
Res.FullDescription: Exchange Rate is based on Rate Type and Date Preference specified in Job Billing Exchange Rate Configuration (at Organization, Account Group, Company or System level).

Res.Caption: Is Override
Res.FullDescription: As you change currency and/or organization on a charge, the unused exchange rates are removed. However, 'Override' exchange rates are not auto-removed and are taken up by new charges with matching criteria.
